info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Healthcare Appointments Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Status API provides access to the current statuses of scheduled healthcare appointments. This endpoint allows users to query the status of their appointments, ensuring they stay informed about any changes or updates. Typical consumers of this API include healthcare providers, office administrators, and applications that integrate appointment management features. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experience by delivering timely and relevant information regarding healthcare appointments.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of appointments in the system. It provides up-to-date information regarding the state of appointments, helping users to stay informed and manage their schedules effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary information to retrieve the current status of appointments. The structure is defined in the associated schema and outlines the required fields and their types.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of appointments.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the status of appointments as a string.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsStatusResponse.title: Appointment Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the appointment.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the appointment.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or message regarding the operation.

ListHealthcareAppointmentsStatusResponse.description: This schema represents the response structure for the GET operation on appointments status.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the appointment entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the appointment entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema provides details about the audit information related to the appointment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
